rawInterface.qualification: Actual same-triangle vertical wall/podium intersection resolves a rim below the deck by at most the existing ordinary 0.5m source-clearance allowance. Requires other strict rim contacts. No horizontal buried floor, floating point, missing support, fully embedded source or coordinate edit is accepted.

interface.qualification: Original support wall upper-edge seams and higher zero-area deck corners only. All original triangles, poses and raw failures retained; strict contact interval and 0.5m wall embedding limit unchanged. Full identity, source terrain/foundation, neighbours, runtime/browser and publication remain separate.
